title: Harmonize compact and comfort button scales across themes
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: We have drift between 'compact' and 'comfort' button scales across themes (light/dark/brand). This manifests as inconsistent tap targets, different icon padding for icon-only buttons, and multiple loading/disabled visual treatments. Several regressions following the token rename in Q4 created mismatched focus rings and opacity values.

Goal: Create a single, token-driven scale specification that covers spacing, touch area, icon spacing, loading overlays, and disabled contrast across all themes. Provide a migration plan and visual regressions to prevent future regressions.
background: Recent product reports and mobile QA flagged accidental tiny touch targets in compact buttons and different spinner placements for icon-only buttons between web and native builds. Designers and engineers attempted local fixes which introduced token fragmentation. This ticket centralizes the fixes and provides safe rollout guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Figma components updated and published in Redesign Library v12 with documented usage examples
CSS variables and migration map committed to design-system repo with automated codemod (PR created)
Visual regression tests added covering: compact vs comfort height, icon-only spinner placement, disabled contrast ratios in light/dark/brand themes
QA checklist: touch target >= 44x44 for compact on mobile, spinner centered vertically and horizontally in icon-only, focus ring visible at 3px in high contrast mode
Rollout plan: feature-flagged bundle for 2 weeks, monitor console UIs and mobile SDK artifacts, revert path documented
tasks: Design: audit current button tokens and produce mapping table (compact->comfort->default)
Design: update Figma components and annotate usage scenarios (icon-only, compound, split)
Engineering: add CSS variables and token aliases, include theme adapters for brand theme
Engineering: implement loading-overlay component that reads token offsets and supports animated spinner positioning
QA: add visual regression snapshots for each theme and variant
Docs: write migration guide with codemod usage and example patches for existing repos
Release: gate via feature flag and schedule a monitored rollout

notes: Edge cases: compound buttons (icon + label + chevron) need special padding rules to avoid label truncation. We will add an optional --btn-compact-truncation-gap token. For on-prem packages, ensure tokens can be overridden via environment stylesheet. Also coordinate with Mobile SDK team to ensure spinner asset and centering math use same token values.
guidance_for_rollout: Ship behind 'button-scale-v2' feature flag. After 1 week of beta usage, enable for console routes with low customer impact first (/settings, /billing) then expand to product routes. Monitor error budget and UI snapshots; revert if regressions > 2% of snapshot diffs in baseline.
final_decision: Use token-first approach, publish Figma variants and codemod, run a 2-week feature-flag rollout. Plan follow-up retro to capture any UX regressions and update tests accordingly.
